name: Online Monocular Neural 3D Reconstruction with Geometric Priors
aliases: Online Monocular Neural 3D Reconstruction with Geometric Priors — MonoNeuralFusion
definition: An online system to reconstruct scene geometry from monocular RGB sequences, using a mapping thread and an optimization thread running in parallel at the back-end to update and refine a sparse feature volume.
summary: MonoNeuralFusion is an online system that incrementally reconstructs 3D geometry from monocular video using a sparse feature volume and geometric priors for real-time, globally coherent results.
